rootCause: Excessive high-frequency radial vibration indicating impending mechanical bearing failure or rotor imbalance.
orderedSteps: Step 1: Safely throttle down or shut down the unit to avoid catastrophic bearing seizure.
Step 2: Inspect outer bearing casing for localized hotspots and perform acoustic emission check.
Step 3: Check dynamic rotor alignment using laser dial indicators; verify balance weights.
Step 4: Inspect bearing raceways and rolling elements for micro-pitting or spalling; replace if defect depth exceeds 0.2mm.
Step 5: Flush lubrication reservoir, check oil ISO cleanliness code (ISO 4406), and replenish with manufacturer-specified grade.
safetyPrecaution: Lock-out/tag-out (LOTO) electrical and pneumatic supplies before disassembling rotating assemblies.

rootCause: Operating temperature continuously elevated beyond normal baseline due to heat exchanger fouling, coolant cavitation, or excessive friction.
orderedSteps: Step 1: Reduce load by 30% immediately to stabilize internal core temperature.
Step 2: Check coolant circulation pump pressure and verify thermostatic bypass valve actuation.
Step 3: Inspect heat exchanger fins/tubes for particulate fouling, scale buildup, or air entrainment.
Step 4: Verify coolant level, pH level, and glycol concentration percentage.
Step 5: Inspect thermal sensor thermocouple calibration and electrical lead resistance.
safetyPrecaution: Allow coolant circuit to depressurize below 0.5 bar and cool below 45°C before opening reservoir caps.

rootCause: Hydraulic or pneumatic pressure deviation indicating relief valve drift, filter clogging, or micro-leakage in line manifolds.
orderedSteps: Step 1: Read differential pressure gauges across suction and discharge filter elements.
Step 2: Inspect hydraulic proportional valves and pilot-operated check valves for stick-slip motion.
Step 3: Perform ultrasonic leak detection across manifold joints and flexible high-pressure hoses.
Step 4: Test accumulator pre-charge nitrogen pressure against specification.
Step 5: Replace clogged 10-micron filter element and recalibrate pressure transducer.
safetyPrecaution: Bleed hydraulic accumulator pressure to zero before loosening any manifold coupling.

rootCause: Stator phase current imbalance or excessive amp draw caused by mechanical binding, turn-to-turn insulation breakdown, or supply voltage unbalance.
orderedSteps: Step 1: Record 3-phase current unbalance percentage: verify it is strictly within < 5%.
Step 2: Perform motor insulation resistance test (Megger test 1000V DC) across phase-to-ground.
Step 3: Rotate shaft by hand with motor de-energized to isolate mechanical binding versus electrical drag.
Step 4: Inspect variable frequency drive (VFD) output waveform and check DC bus capacitor ripple voltage.
Step 5: Verify terminal block bolt torques and check for discoloration indicative of thermal oxidation.
safetyPrecaution: Confirm zero voltage across all 3 phases and discharge VFD DC bus capacitors before touching terminals.

rootCause: Inlet line restriction, strainer blockage, or impeller cavitation causing sudden drop in volumetric flow throughput.
orderedSteps: Step 1: Check suction strainer vacuum gauge reading for restriction.
Step 2: Inspect intake piping for air ingress or vortex formation at reservoir inlet.
Step 3: Disassemble pump casing to inspect impeller leading edges for cavitation pitting.
Step 4: Clean or backflush intake basket strainer.
Step 5: Re-prime system and verify Net Positive Suction Head Available (NPSHa) exceeds NPSHr.
safetyPrecaution: Depressurize and isolate suction and discharge gate valves before disassembling pump housing.

rootCause: Unusual multivariate pattern detected exceeding baseline empirical confidence envelope.
orderedSteps: Step 1: Inspect primary and secondary sensor cabling for grounding noise or intermittent loose connections.
Step 2: Run calibration diagnostics against known reference test standards.
Step 3: Cross-check ambient environmental conditions (ambient temp, humidity, vibration harmonics).
Step 4: Schedule preventative maintenance inspection of corresponding subsystem within 48 hours.
safetyPrecaution: Follow standard plant safety protocols and observe PPE requirements during physical inspection.
